Open interpretation questions

Candidate interpretation, not legally reviewed.

  • AE-LAW29-01

    Whether Articles 7 and 20 apply to government websites, apps and digital services, or only to the formats and services expressly listed, requires legal review.

    Recorded observation: Article 7 covers expression, Braille, sign language, other communication means and information; Article 20(2) lists electronic texts, sign language, Braille, audio and multimedia.

    Provision P-03

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Qualified legal review.

  • AE-LAW29-02

    The implementing Cabinet decision and technical standards contemplated by Article 23 are not captured; their content and current status are unresolved.

    Recorded observation: Article 23 requires the competent authorities to set engineering standards and a Cabinet decision to issue controls and exemptions.

    Provision P-05

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Source capture.

  • AE-LAW29-03

    The relationship between this 2006 Law, Cabinet Resolution 43/2018 and the 2024 National Digital Accessibility Policy needs a consolidated reading.

    Recorded observation: The Law, the 2018 Cabinet Resolution and the 2024 policy address different aspects of disability inclusion and digital accessibility.

    Provision P-01

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Qualified legal review.

  • AE-LAW29-04

    The official English translation and the Arabic text may differ; Arabic prevails and native legal review is outstanding.

    Recorded observation: The UAE Legislation platform provides an English translation and states that the Arabic text prevails in case of conflict.

    Provision P-03

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Translation review.
